decisions.reason: The rye country bread is a core part of the firm's established traditional bread range and uses existing know-how and facilities, so management will keep defending the investment.
The premium raisin stollen is the publicly announced flagship and has won repeated gold medals, so both visible commitment and proven success make keeping it clear.
The dark barley malt rye is a niche variant, but it shares production with the core breads, and any weak demand can still be attributed to temporary causes, so management sticks with it.
The marzipan stollen complements the flagship stollen in the committed Christmas gift business, so dropping it would undercut the firm's announced seasonal direction.
